_comment: Stagenet test fixtures only - stagenet XMR has no monetary value, so persisting these keys here is safe and deliberate (it lets the E2E test in e2e/README.md be re-run without regenerating wallets or re-funding from the faucet every time). Never do this with mainnet keys.

customer.known_txids_comment: Every txid that ever paid this wallet - the two original faucet payouts plus every test run's own tx (its change output pays the wallet again). tests/e2e_stagenet.rs scans all of these each run (skipping any not yet confirmed) and appends its own new tx here on success, so later runs automatically pick up earlier change without needing a fresh faucet payout every time.
customer.mnemonic: affair cube ablaze cynical lurk gather arises last oatmeal guide sniff tufts lyrics wounded zigzags deftly tapestry tipsy pests ingested vain feast cottage duration wounded
customer.role: The payer - needs full spend capability to receive faucet funds and send the test payment to whatever address moneropay derives for an order. tests/e2e_stagenet.rs uses private_spend_key/private_view_key directly (via the monero-wallet crate) to scan for its own received outputs and sign a real spend, with no external wallet-rpc process involved. private_spend_key/private_view_key were extracted once via `monero-wallet-rpc`'s query_key RPC (run in --offline mode, since a wedge was observed when query_key raced an online wallet-rpc's automatic post-restore refresh); the mnemonic is kept only as a human-recoverable backup of the same key material.

merchant.role: The moneropay tenant under test - watch-only. Only private_view_key and spend_public_key are ever given to moneropay; private_spend_key/mnemonic are recorded here only so this wallet can be fully recovered/inspected later, not because moneropay needs them.
